tasks.subject: Lock architecture, provenance, scope, and verification contract
Add typed visual asset catalog and remove stale actor spritesheet configuration
Apply Kenney portraits, Ground Shaker identity, and six weapon icon mappings
Apply three stage surface themes and six coherent object visuals and legend entries
Harden all five weather visuals and clear-state cleanup
Add focused unit and Phase 9 browser coverage
Run full verification, visual review, and MainScene LOC gate
Refresh project status, execution handoff, and next-task automation
Obtain independent review and run manual drift/postflight gates

acceptanceMap.A1: Product-owner approval and an interface-first three-layer architecture are recorded before implementation.
acceptanceMap.A2: A typed source-aware catalog replaces scattered paths and the unused actor spritesheet configuration is removed.
acceptanceMap.A3: Kenney portraits identify player and enemy, Ground Shaker tanks remain world actors, and all six weapons resolve a distinct HUD icon with one fallback.
acceptanceMap.A4: Three stages have distinct low-contrast surfaces and six map-object kinds have coherent world visuals with a matching legend.
acceptanceMap.A5: All five weather types are immediately distinguishable and clear weather resets particles, fog, tint, and flash.
acceptanceMap.A6: Focused unit and browser tests cover the catalog and visual contracts without console errors.
acceptanceMap.A7: Type-check, lint, full unit, build, full Playwright, screenshot review, and MainScene LOC gates pass.
acceptanceMap.A8: The dashboard status reports Phase 9 complete and next-tasks advances to the next bounded product decision.
acceptanceMap.A9: An independent reviewer passes the final tree and manual drift/postflight gates are clean.
